req_desc: The product serves a public marketing surface plus a governed console behind one identity system ...
A developer may open a promotion request ...
POST /api/auth/login takes an email plus a password, returning an access token ...
A team is addressed by slug at the first path segment, so `/northwind/checkout-web` names the checkout-web project ...
The deployment states are `QUEUED`, `BUILDING`, `READY`, `ERROR`, `CANCELED`, `PROMOTING`, `LIVE`, `SUPERSEDED` ...
The seeded production policy is `Production two-eyes`, version `1`, requiring `2` approvals from `release-reviewers` ...
Every state change writes one audit record carrying a gapless per-organisation sequence number ...
A firewall rule action is one of `allow`, `deny`, `challenge`, `log`, `rate-limit`, `bypass` ...
Money is integer minor units in usd everywhere, no floating-point value touching a monetary amount ...
Notification recipients are resolved from roles plus access groups at the moment of the event
A query aggregate is one of `AVG`, `SUM`, `MAX`, `MIN`, `count`, `p50`, `p75`, `p90`, `p95`, `p99` ...
The public routes are `/`, `/pricing`, `/enterprise`, `/security`, `/docs`, `/templates`, `/blog`, `/changelog`, `/customers`, `/ai`, `/i`, `/login`, `/signup` ...
An unauthenticated request for a console route redirects to /login carrying the requested path as a return target ...
Body text meets WCAG AA at four point five to one against its ground ...
The frontend is Preact with Vite, served as a production static build ...
The mark is drawn geometry in four forms rather than an image file ...
All timestamps are stored in UTC ...
No real build execution happens, a build being a recorded state machine ...
The app is reachable at APP_PUBLIC_URL ...
core asks covered by this grader
